build_eomt_segmentation_model: build an EoMT model for universal segmentation using EomtForUniversalSegmentation with image inputs
run_eomt_hungarian_matcher: run the EomtHungarianMatcher to compute bipartite matching between predicted and ground truth segmentation masks
compute_eomt_loss: compute the EomtLoss combining cross-entropy, mask, and dice losses for segmentation training
run_eomt_attention: run EomtAttention with multi-headed attention on transformer hidden states
build_eomt_transformer_layer: build an EomtLayer transformer block with attention, MLP, layer norm, and layer scale
